entries.notes: All nine parameterized TypeScript declarations are covered by the production workflow-core Rust implementation and differential oracle. The Rust tests add exact negative-zero and negative-infinity boundaries while preserving safe-integer advancement, null/empty logs, event filtering, owner-scoped counts, totalAttempts as bare starts plus the largest single owner, the workflow#3069 racer regression, genuine retry ceilings, and mixed owned-to-bare ceilings. Internal Rust accounting uses the private StepAttemptCount integer type; f64 exists only at the JavaScript compatibility boundary. The dedicated Rust core workflow runs Rustfmt, compilation, all tests, Clippy with warnings denied, the TypeScript oracle, and cross-language differential fixtures.
